patterns.title: Reuse is published before asynchronous cleanup finishes
patterns.summary: An arena/session becomes available for reuse while cleanup, reset, or lease teardown from the previous generation can still mutate shared state.
detectionHints: Compare idle/reusable publication with completion of asynchronous reset and teardown work.
Track generation ownership for deferred callbacks and resource leases.
Prove old work cannot commit into the next run.
retestFocus: Restart the same arena immediately after reset begins.
Observe old deferred work during new setup/gameplay.
Repeat under concurrent arena pressure.

patterns.title: Runtime world rules drift from authored gameplay requirements
patterns.summary: Gamerules, time, weather, or environment state do not match the selected artifact's authored gameplay requirement and are not restored by session setup.
detectionHints: Compare authored rule intent with world defaults and every session setup writer.
Check whether a required gamerule/environment state is actually committed before gameplay.
Track restoration after restart/reload.
retestFocus: Start from altered world rule/time/weather state.
Run a complete session and restart.
Verify death/inventory behavior where gamerules affect gameplay.

patterns.title: Cancelled client-predicted mutation is not reconciled
patterns.summary: The server rejects or reverses a predicted player mutation but the initiating client can retain a stale visual/local state until another synchronization event.
detectionHints: Identify client-predicted interactions whose authoritative mutation is cancelled.
Check whether an explicit authoritative state refresh follows cancellation.
Keep native reconciliation uncertainty runtime-owned when static evidence cannot decide it.
retestFocus: Perform the blocked mutation from one client while another observes.
Compare initiator and remote-client state.
Force chunk/player resync and verify convergence.

patterns.title: Configured gameplay capability is not reachable by the player
patterns.summary: A configured offer, item, action, or capability exists in data but is omitted from the player-facing route that should expose it.
detectionHints: Compare configured gameplay entries with menu/action routing and eligibility filters.
Treat configuration presence as intent evidence only when selected-artifact routing supports that interpretation.
Identify entries with no player-reachable presentation path.
retestFocus: Open every relevant shop/menu state.
Compare configured entries with rendered options.
Repeat across role/level variants.

patterns.title: Session-local operation mutates another session
patterns.summary: A supposedly arena/session-local cleanup or periodic operation uses world-global players, tags, selectors, or coordinates and mutates unrelated sessions.
detectionHints: Trace selector/session scope from the local owner to every mutation target.
Compare arena/session identity carried by the caller with the actual selection used at commit.
Search cleanup and periodic maintenance for world-global effects.
retestFocus: Run two arenas concurrently with distinct state.
Trigger cleanup in only one arena.
Keep unrelated players near mutable surfaces and verify isolation.

patterns.title: Unintended cross-session serialization
patterns.summary: Independent arena/session flows share global transition state or a single queue, causing one session to delay another.
detectionHints: Search for singleton queue, global scoreboard, or shared cutscene state.
Start two arenas within the same short time window.
Verify each session can advance without waiting for unrelated sessions.
retestFocus: Concurrent start in two arenas.
Disconnect one arena while another enters cutscene.
Repeat with maximum supported arena occupancy.

patterns.title: Deferred work escapes progression accounting
patterns.summary: Queued, delayed, retry, or deferred gameplay work is not represented in the authoritative outstanding-work count, so progression can complete early or become inconsistent.
detectionHints: Separate requested, pending, materialized, live, and completed work.
Require every retry/deferred unit to remain owned by progression accounting until terminal disposition.
Check success transitions while delayed work still exists.
retestFocus: Force spawn/action retry paths.
Advance the wave while retries are pending.
Repeat with disconnect and chunk-loading pressure.

patterns.title: Developer capability is reachable through normal gameplay
patterns.summary: Debug, skip, coordinate, restart, or maintenance capability can be acquired or triggered by an ordinary player path.
detectionHints: Trace acquisition and trigger paths from ordinary inventory/crafting/gameplay resources.
Require an active role/capability guard at the exact effect commit.
Distinguish unreachable maintenance code from player-reachable production exposure.
retestFocus: Attempt acquisition as an ordinary player.
Trigger the capability without operator/admin state.
Repeat after role changes and reconnect.

patterns.title: Entity route does not converge to objective
patterns.summary: An entity remains alive but cannot reach its required destination, causing wave or objective progression to stall or behave incorrectly.
detectionHints: Observe path convergence rather than only successful spawn.
Check barriers, elevation changes, collision, and target reacquisition.
Treat a live unreachable entity as progression risk.
retestFocus: Run affected wave repeatedly.
Test after Minecraft entity/navigation updates.
Observe route from spawn through every choke point.

patterns.title: Invalid gameplay target remains eligible
patterns.summary: An actor that has transitioned into a state that should exclude it from targeting or assistance remains eligible because predicates are not re-evaluated against the new state.
detectionHints: Re-evaluate target/helper eligibility after state transitions.
Test held-input conditions that cross the transition boundary.
Separate actor identity from actor eligibility.
retestFocus: Enter knockdown while hostile targets are already acquired.
Hold revive input before knockdown.
Test helper/no-helper boundaries with multiple players.

patterns.title: Non-atomic purchase and effect application
patterns.summary: Currency is committed before the purchased gameplay effect is confirmed, allowing payment without successful delivery.
detectionHints: Trace currency deduction and effect application as one transaction.
Force effect/application failure after eligibility succeeds.
Verify failed delivery cannot permanently consume currency.
retestFocus: Purchase with exact required balance.
Repeat purchase under inventory/equipment edge conditions.
Interrupt or close UI during purchase.

patterns.title: Non-idempotent progression purchase
patterns.summary: A progression state that should be owned once remains purchasable, allowing repeated payment without new progression.
detectionHints: Compare owned-state checks before rendering offers and before committing payment.
Reopen the shop after ownership changes.
Verify repeated interaction cannot consume currency for the same tier.
retestFocus: Buy each tier then reopen the shop.
Reconnect after purchase and retry.
Attempt repeated activation if multiplayer UI allows it.

patterns.title: Presented capacity exceeds deliverable concurrent capacity
patterns.summary: Player-facing or spatially presented session capacity exceeds the concurrency the runtime ownership/resource model can actually deliver.
detectionHints: Compare visible/advertised arena count with admission and shared-resource limits.
Trace the actual lease/ticking-area/session cap at the start commit boundary.
Treat lower hidden throughput as a design mismatch unless the reduced capacity is explicitly authored to players.
retestFocus: Start sessions until the presented capacity is reached.
Verify the first rejected/queued session against visible capacity.
Repeat after resource-limit or ticking-area changes.

patterns.title: Privileged role bypass escapes gameplay world protection
patterns.summary: An operator/roommaster/admin role retains mutation capability inside gameplay space where the selected artifact expects arena protection to remain authoritative.
detectionHints: Model gameplay role separately from platform privilege.
Trace mutation authorization at the exact protected-world commit.
Verify maintenance privileges are bounded to intended surfaces and phases.
retestFocus: Attempt block/entity mutation as each privileged role during gameplay.
Repeat after role assignment/reconnect.
Verify allowed maintenance surfaces remain usable.

patterns.title: Reconnect state discontinuity
patterns.summary: A player reconnects into a valid session identity but required gameplay state such as loadout, inventory, role, or phase is not reconstructed consistently.
detectionHints: Compare session assignment restoration with inventory/loadout restoration.
Test reconnect at every phase boundary, not only active gameplay.
Check whether restoration depends on transient entities or tags.
retestFocus: Reconnect during cutscene.
Reconnect during setup and active phase.
Reconnect after death/knockdown when applicable.

patterns.title: Reload recovery loses active-session continuity
patterns.summary: Reload/server recovery restores session identity but loses required active progression, timeline, world, or objective state and can abort or diverge from the pre-reload session.
detectionHints: Inventory every active-session state owner that must survive or be deterministically reconstructed.
Compare normal transition initialization with reload recovery initialization.
Track deferred timers/world mutations that cannot be reconstructed from persisted state.
retestFocus: Reload during each active phase boundary.
Reload while delayed work or world objectives are pending.
Verify continued completion without restart/abort.

patterns.title: Repeated arena replica diverges from required baseline
patterns.summary: One repeated arena/region is structurally incomplete or materially different from its sibling baseline in a way that changes gameplay.
detectionHints: Normalize repeated regions before comparing structure/topology.
Separate intentional authored variation from missing gameplay-required geometry.
Bind divergence to a gameplay dependency before classification.
retestFocus: Compare every repeated arena footprint.
Exercise the divergent region's gameplay route.
Recheck after world-copy/structure-generation changes.

patterns.title: Required item lifecycle loss
patterns.summary: A gameplay-critical or progression item can leave the player's valid state through durability, drop, cleanup, or restore behavior without an equivalent recovery path.
detectionHints: Model required items through break, drop, death, cleanup, reconnect, and upgrade transitions.
Verify every destructive item path has an intentional replacement/recovery rule.
Check upgraded variants separately from base items.
retestFocus: Exhaust durability.
Attempt drop after every upgrade tier.
Death/reconnect with required item in each inventory slot.

patterns.title: Reset omits a gameplay-significant mutation class
patterns.summary: Session/round reset restores only some mutable state classes, allowing entities, blocks, capabilities, or other residue from a previous run to survive into the next.
detectionHints: Build reset scope from the mutation footprint rather than a fixed cleanup list.
Compare all player/world/entity mutations with reset/preserve ownership.
Run a second-session differential after maximal mutation.
retestFocus: Create every player-authorized mutable object/state before reset.
Start a second run and diff the initial state.
Repeat after reconnect/reload.

patterns.title: Displayed or persisted result diverges from authored result semantics
patterns.summary: Scoring thresholds, win/draw classification, leaderboard persistence, or reward state encode a different result than the selected artifact's authored scoring/result rules.
detectionHints: Derive the authored scoring/result table and compare every calculation branch.
Trace terminal classification through display and persistence writers.
Check boundary values and ties explicitly.
retestFocus: Exercise every scoring threshold boundary.
Produce ties/draws and normal wins.
Compare UI result with persisted counters/leaderboard.

patterns.title: Player state leaks across role or session boundaries
patterns.summary: Capabilities, equipment, inventory subcontainers, or temporary role state survive a transition where the new role/session should receive a clean authoritative state.
detectionHints: Model inventory, equipment/offhand, abilities and role capabilities as separate mutable surfaces.
Compare mutation footprint of the old role with cleanup performed before the new role commits.
Check exit, replay and reconnect paths for the same boundary.
retestFocus: Acquire state in every managed player container as the old role.
Transition to every successor role/lobby/replay path.
Reconnect across the transition.

patterns.title: Independent player actions share a blocking input resource
patterns.summary: Two semantically independent actions reuse one cooldown/category/token/lock so activating one unintentionally disables the other.
detectionHints: Build reverse ownership from cooldown/lock/category resources to actions.
Flag shared blocking resources only when actions are semantically independent.
Check safety/escape controls against gameplay anti-spam locks.
retestFocus: Trigger one action then immediately use the other.
Reverse action order.
Repeat around phase transitions and reconnect.

patterns.title: Spawn position nondeterminism
patterns.summary: The same logical spawn sequence produces materially different positions across equivalent runs, risking pathing and progression divergence.
detectionHints: Capture exact spawn coordinates across repeated equivalent runs.
Check relative execution origin and loaded-area state.
Compare command context and placement fallback behavior.
retestFocus: Repeat the same spawn sequence many times.
Test after teleports and chunk reloads.
Compare local-hosted and dedicated-server execution when applicable.

patterns.title: Stale membership snapshot at gameplay transition
patterns.summary: A transition commits using an earlier player-membership snapshot instead of revalidating current eligibility immediately before start.
detectionHints: Look for countdown or queue state captured before the final transition.
Compare membership checks at countdown start versus transition commit.
Exercise leave/disconnect/switch-arena during the final transition window.
retestFocus: Leave the join area during the last countdown seconds.
Disconnect and reconnect during setup.
Run concurrent arena starts with membership changes.

patterns.title: Team relationship does not isolate friendly damage
patterns.summary: Players who are teammates under the selected gameplay contract remain valid damage targets through combat rules or damage paths.
detectionHints: Resolve authoritative team relationship and every damage path.
Check world/game rules plus scripted damage and projectile ownership.
Do not infer friendly-fire intent from platform defaults alone.
retestFocus: Exercise melee, projectile, area and scripted damage between teammates.
Repeat after team/role reassignment.
Verify cross-team damage still works.

patterns.title: Authored terminal condition is practically unreachable
patterns.summary: Damage, health, timing, or resource values make an authored failure/success condition effectively unreachable during intended gameplay.
detectionHints: Quantify terminal-state budget against all legal effect rates and session duration.
Distinguish intentionally difficult conditions from mathematically or operationally unreachable ones.
Cross-check displayed objective stakes with actual transition reachability.
retestFocus: Run maximum plausible damage/effect throughput.
Measure objective state over a full session.
Test edge player counts and upgrades.

patterns.title: Equivalent UI state renders inconsistent presentation
patterns.summary: Returning to the same logical gameplay/menu state produces a materially different player-facing UI representation without an authored state difference.
detectionHints: Key presentation to semantic state rather than navigation history.
Compare initial entry and return paths to the same state.
Separate cosmetic variation from information/action inconsistency.
retestFocus: Enter, leave, and return to each menu state.
Repeat after purchase and cancel paths.
Compare action labels/options across equivalent states.

patterns.title: Unloaded-area action advances gameplay state
patterns.summary: Gameplay progression assumes a spawn or world action succeeded even though its target area was not loaded/ticking, allowing skipped content or premature completion.
detectionHints: Separate action request from confirmed runtime outcome.
Check chunk/ticking readiness before spawn or structure-dependent actions.
Ensure counters advance only after outcome confirmation.
retestFocus: Move all players away from spawn regions.
Exercise wave transitions immediately after teleport/cutscene.
Repeat after reconnect and server restart.

patterns.title: World geometry blocks a required gameplay transition
patterns.summary: A structure, fill, restored block, or actor-interaction limitation leaves required route/interaction geometry blocked when the next gameplay step depends on it.
detectionHints: Cross-check previous/current world writers against the next scenario's required route or interaction.
Verify actors have the required break/use/navigation capability for blocking geometry.
Treat shared-space stage transitions as one stateful system.
retestFocus: Traverse the required route immediately after transition.
Run actor interactions against restored/placed blockers.
Repeat after reset and second run.
